overview: Stormbreaker Isles are the Twilight Sea’s storm-forged archipelago, created by elemental eruptions and shaped by violent winds and arcane lightning.
history: The Isles formed when elemental nodes beneath the Sea erupted violently.
Combine researchers attempted to stabilize the region but failed.
Mariner clans used the Isles as temporary storm shelters during calm cycles.
Elemental manifestations claimed the Isles as territory.
Siren Courts avoid the Isles due to unpredictable lightning surges.
hooks: A mega-storm forms above the Isles, threatening nearby regions.
Lightning geysers reveal a buried Combine structure.
Elemental manifestations begin migrating toward the Twilight Reef.
A floating island destabilizes and begins to fall.
